content: There have been different proposed approaches for representing mathematical equations. BIBREF8 introduced the symbol layout tree, a representation that encodes the spatial relationship of variables and operators for the purpose of indexing and retrieving mathematical equations. Our work also falls into the framework of mathematical language processing (MLP) BIBREF9 whose first step is converting mathematical solutions into a series of numerical features.
